liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **It's Gonna Be (Alright)**: back after 40 archived shows (852 days); rare: 11 archived performances [8]
- **Drums**: rare: 11 archived performances [8]

## The recordings

- **ween2019-10-31.mbho.ka300.ka500.matrix.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 31 songs; 155 min [1]
- **ween2019-10-31.MK012**: source not stated; 31 songs; 154 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer judges this MK012 recording the best-sounding of the show's available recordings [7]
- **ween2019-10-31.ak40.722**: source not stated; 31 songs; 154 min [3]
- **ween2019-10-31.at853**: source not stated; 31 songs; 155 min [4]

## Around the show

- Battery failure meant Transitions and part of Never Squeal were spliced in from a Tascam DR40 recording by another taper (at853) [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **ween2019-10-31.mbho.ka300.ka500.matrix.flac16**: taped by teamikoiko; transferred by teamikoiko; source: Source: MBHO ka300 (ORTF, 14ft, OTS/roc) + MBHO ka500 (DINa)>Naiant PFA>MixPre6 (SD Card @ 24/48) [1]. Also: Transferred from hard drive via Reaper with dither and resampling, tracked in CDWav, encoded to FLAC level 6, tagged in Foobar2000 [1]
- **ween2019-10-31.MK012**: Recorded with Oktava MK021 mics into a Fostex FR2-LE at 24/48, from the rail behind the soundboard [2]
- **ween2019-10-31.ak40.722**: taped by Melissa Fry; transferred by Melissa Fry; source: Neumann AK40> Sound Devices 722 [3]
- **ween2019-10-31.at853**: source: at853>tascam dr40 [4]
